title: 1828. Template-Based Shape Processor with Downcasting & Cross Casting
description:
sting
50
Medium
Template-Based Shape Processor with Downcasting & Cross Casting
Problem Statement:
You are required to design a shape processing system using:
Base class
Derived classes
Template function
dynamic_cast for downcasting and cross casting
🔹 Class Hierarchy
       Shape   (Base class – polymorphic)
       /   \
  Circle   Rectangle
🔹 Requirements
1️⃣ Base Class
class Shape {
public:
   virtual void display() = 0;
   virtual ~Shape() {}
};
(Make it polymorphic using virtual function.)
2️⃣ Derived Classes
Circle
Data member: radius
Function: area()
Rectangle
Data members: length, width
Function: area()
3️⃣ Template Function
Create a function template:
template <typename T>
void processShape(Shape* ptr);
Inside the function:
Try downcasting:
T* derived = dynamic_cast<T*>(ptr);
If successful:
Print area
If failed:
Print:
Invalid cast
🔹 Input Format
type
values
cast_type
Where:
type → circle or rectangle
values:
circle → radius
rectangle → length width
cast_type → circle or rectangle
🔹 Output Rules
If cast succeeds:
Area: <value>
If cast fails:
Invalid cast
